time.nullEnd: next start or final composed duration
time.durationShortening: clip evaluation only; keep saved regions

priority: emphasis: exempt primary, tiledAux and all owned plates; no avoidance conflict diagnostic
manual area or lockedAreas or lockedEffects: preserve non-emphasis values; report actual conflict, never shrink/unlock
center-anchor layouts: center only, ignore radius and retain center word/disc
ordinary automatic primary: full-stage trajectory; no circle mask
tiledAux: unchanged placement, mask only owned repetitions/plates

auxMask.alpha: 0 if d<=R; smoothstep(0,1,(d-R)/F) if R<d<R+F; 1 otherwise
auxMask.scope: tiledAux and owned plates only; primary, independentDecor and media unchanged
auxMask.order: per draw event after spatial FX; retain original painter order and blend against actual destination
auxMask.unsupported: non-separable post-FX mixing roles without provenance: explicit unsupported diagnostic; never silently claim safety

size.explicit: preserve notation size; conflict diagnostic if no fit
size.rubyStrokeShadow: include glyph/ruby/stroke; bounded shadow envelope through alpha threshold; unbounded FX unsupported

fx.guarantee: transformed primary ink polygon including camera, enter/hold/exit and bounded copies; alpha >= 1/255
fx.positionPreference: center: all sides; upper: left/right/below; lower: left/right/above
fx.fallback: explicit insufficient-space or unsupported, never mask primary or shrink whole effect

performance.environment: same browser, local font, viewport and warmup; compare in 004/017
performance.bufferBudget: 004/018 must measure lifetime and impose max buffers; no per-glyph stage buffer

ownership: default all lyric-bearing draw units to primary; only named reviewed auxiliary units exempt; unresolved unit ownership remains adapter verification pending, not successful

sourceKinds.user: emphasis exemption, fixed switching, center-only orbit and tiled auxiliary exclusion
sourceKinds.adoptedDesign: all numeric bounds, defaults, mask smoothstep/width, margin, conflict and FX diagnostics
sourceKinds.pending: adapter-level unit ownership and full FX implementation in 004-012/018, persistence in 013, UI in 014-015, export/AE diagnostics in 016

adaptiveLayoutsA.eligibility: only native joint-translation insufficient; existing safe unchanged
adaptiveLayoutsA.selection: hard constraints, declared per-ID order, first admissible candidate; fixed within region; deterministic
adaptiveLayoutsA.explicitSize: preserve lyricSize and explicit contentScale; no reduction
adaptiveLayoutsA.failure: explicit excluded-during-avoidance/no-certified-composition; preserve lyrics; no implicit fallback without proven automatic origin

entryExitRelaxation.only: source-tagged geometrically moving events; each pass uses native motionTime, realTime selects region
entryExitRelaxation.hold: all stationary events always strict; moving events strict throughout hold
entryExitRelaxation.status: safe-hold / certified-hold-adapter distinct from full-interval safe
entryExitRelaxation.exitStart: cut.end-cut.outDur; geometric movement only, not fade/reveal
entryExitRelaxation.ghost: classify each pass separately; persistent drift includes native ltb lag/quantization range

adaptiveLayoutsA.ownedQuality: complete pre-clip ink; owned body/metadata zones; post-solution independent opaque-field and correct-half checks
adaptiveLayoutsA.failureBudget: explicit CUT_CANDIDATE_BUDGET; no claim all candidates exhausted
recipeTestingOrder: existing full native joint certificate unchanged
source-moving-event relaxation with stationary events always strict
each native-size ID recipe: full interval then moving-event-only relaxation
each discrete reduced-size recipe: full interval then moving-event-only relaxation
explicit exclusion; preserve original lyric-bearing cut
adaptiveLayoutsA.measureCandidates: at most eight area-ordered outer-band/circle-chord measures per strategy/scale
adaptiveLayoutsA.sourceCoverage: ordered grapheme ranges checked independently per primary copy; native metadata text/font/count checked separately
adaptiveLayoutsA.budgetBias: first chronological regions may consume 128 unique recipe budget; later budget failures explicitly identify untested candidates; seek never reruns planning

proofCache.privateGeometry: lossless Float64 coordinates + Uint32 polygon lengths; decoded owned frozen arrays
proofCache.limitMeaning: encoded retained data, not JavaScript heap
proofCache.candidatePrograms: direct recording; rejected programs do not enter common preparation LRU
